title: Low-depth amplitude estimation via statistical eigengap estimation
summary: Amplitude estimation, in its original form, is formulated as phase estimation upon the Grover iterate. Subsequent improvements to the algorithm have eliminated the need for phase estimation and introduced low-depth variants that trade speedups for lower circuit depth. We make the key observation that amplitude estimation is equivalent to estimating the energy gap of an effective Hamiltonian, whereby discrete-time evolution is generated by amplitude amplification.
